title: Week 41: Startup Performance and Profiles Checkpoint

questions.prompt: Checkpoint: What distinguishes TTFD from TTID?
questions.explanation: TTID ends at first frame; TTFD represents the app-defined point when meaningful critical content is fully drawn and usable. This applies the lesson's evidence and recovery model.
options: Measure explicit startup modes and signal full display only when meaningful content is usable.
Mix startup modes in one average
questions.answer: Measure explicit startup modes and signal full display only when meaningful content is usable.

questions.prompt: Select the two sound practices for startup critical path, providers, and main-thread blocking.
questions.explanation: Libraries can contribute providers and components that initialise before the Activity and are absent from the app’s source manifest. This applies the lesson's evidence and recovery model.
options: Remove nonessential dependencies from the startup critical path rather than merely changing their thread.
Record representative evidence and an owned recovery action
Use splash time as extra budget
answer: Remove nonessential dependencies from the startup critical path rather than merely changing their thread.
Record representative evidence and an owned recovery action

questions.prompt: App Startup automatically moves every initializer off the main thread.
questions.explanation: Must this work complete before the first meaningful UI/action, or can its owning feature initialise it later? This applies the lesson's evidence and recovery model.

questions.prompt: Complete the operational rule: Why is compilation mode part of the benchmark result?
questions.explanation: ART compilation materially changes execution cost, so results with different modes are not directly comparable. This applies the lesson's evidence and recovery model.
questions.answer: ART compilation materially changes execution cost, so results with different modes are not directly comparable.
acceptedAnswers: ART compilation materially changes execution cost, so results with different modes are not directly comparable.

questions.prompt: Order the investigation steps for baseline profiles for critical user journeys.
questions.explanation: They ship with the release for first-launch benefit, while Cloud Profiles aggregate after real usage and arrive later. This applies the lesson's evidence and recovery model.
options: Name the user or release outcome
answer: Name the user or release outcome
